# Exera Ltd

> Exera Ltd is a Mauritian software company (founded 2021) that builds tailor-made software: custom apps, web, mobile and the EXRP cloud ERP. Made in Moris certified, green-hosted, serving clients in 8+ countries. Its founders bring 10+ years of combined software experience across companies and countries.

Exera comes on site, learns how a business really works, and builds software around it. All products are Made in Moris certified (80%+ local production, SGS verified) and run on clean, energy-efficient "green" servers. Exera was named a Sustainability Champion in its Made in Moris cohort (2025).

Primary contact is WhatsApp (+230 5944 0110). Fastest way to reach the team for a project enquiry or EXRP demo.

## Pages

- [Home](https://exera.mu/): Overview of services, green-server hosting, Made in Moris certification, clients, reviews and contact.
- [Home (Markdown)](https://exera.mu/index.md): Token-efficient Markdown version of the homepage.
- [EXRP — Cloud ERP](https://exera.mu/exrp/): EXRP cloud ERP for startups and SMEs. Unlimited invoices, products, customers and transactions. Fixed pricing, MRA E-Invoicing compliant, modules, analytics, payment and WhatsApp integration.
- [Terms of Service](https://exera.mu/terms.html): Website and service terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://exera.mu/privacy.html): How Exera handles data.

## Services

- Custom software development (bespoke systems built around a client's workflow)
- Web applications
- Mobile apps (iOS & Android)
- System integration
- Maintenance and ongoing support
- Technology consulting
- EXRP — cloud-based ERP (invoicing, inventory, orders, POS, analytics, more)

## Facts

- Company: Exera Ltd, IconEbene, Ebene, Mauritius
- Founded: 2021 (founders bring 10+ years of combined software experience)
- Countries served: Mauritius, India, United States, France, Switzerland, Thailand, Turkey, China
- Certification: Made in Moris (SGS verified, 80%+ local), Sustainability Champions 2025
- Hosting: green, energy-efficient servers
- EXRP: MRA E-Invoicing compliant, fixed pricing, unlimited records
